provenance.source: Azure Billing Benefits REST API — SavingsPlanOrderModel (Microsoft.BillingBenefits savingsPlanOrders, list)
provenance.field_names_from: Azure/azure-rest-api-specs specification/billingbenefits/resource-manager/Microsoft.BillingBenefits/BillingBenefits/stable/2022-11-01/billingbenefits.json (SavingsPlanOrderModelProperties, Term P1Y/P3Y/P5Y, BillingPlan P1M, ProvisioningState); P1M as a term is from api-version 2026-06-01
provenance.notes: REST shape: the order JSON is flattened so 'properties.*' become dot-path columns (e.g. az rest --method get --url '/providers/Microsoft.BillingBenefits/savingsPlanOrders?api-version=2022-11-01'). One row per savings plan ORDER, keyed by its ARM id lowercased (Azure ARM ids are case-insensitive); a Contract Commitment source must key the same way. term maps to the FOCUS duration. billingPlan P1M is the monthly plan (no upfront, monthly payments); an order without billingPlan is not mapped, because 'absent means upfront' is not stated by the API. provisioningState maps without a clock: Succeeded=Active, Expired, Cancelled=Canceled, creation/billing states=Pending; Failed has no FOCUS lifecycle value. BenefitCategory=Discount and Model=Continuous are invariant for savings plans (FOCUS 1.4 glossary: a commitment discount). Not emitted: FulfillmentInterval (the commitment grain is on the plan, and api-version 2026-06-01 adds FullTerm besides Hourly), Created (the order has no creation timestamp), OfferCategory, LastUpdated, Applicability, DiscountPercentage and InvoiceIssuerName.
